name: Fix Menu 1 Link 7 - Two DOCX Before Close

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: zainnet-link7-two-word-fix
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  fix:
    name: Fix Auto Download 2 Word, check build, commit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout latest main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: true
      - name: Setup Node 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - name: Apply scoped source patch (no quota or payment changes)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > /tmp/zainnet_fix_link7.py <<'PY_FIX'
          #!/usr/bin/env python3
          """ZAIN.NET Menu 1 Link 7: two independent Word downloads, no premature exit.
          
          Run in root of Karyazainnet repository. Scope: three frontend TSX/TS files.
          Fail closed if the expected source structure differs.
          """
          from pathlib import Path
          
          APP = Path('src/journalConverter/App.tsx')
          MODAL = Path('src/components/ToolViewerModal.tsx')
          COVER = Path('src/journalConverter/utils/coverCdExport.ts')
          MARKER = 'ZAINNET_LINK7_TWO_DOCX_SAFE_CLOSE_20261109'
          
          
          def replace_one(s: str, old: str, new: str, what: str) -> str:
              n = s.count(old)
              if n != 1:
                  raise RuntimeError(f'{what}: expected 1 exact match, got {n}. No files were changed.')
              return s.replace(old, new, 1)
          
          
          def fix_app(original: str) -> str:
              s = original
              if MARKER in s:
                  return s
              s = replace_one(s, "import { exportJournalToDocx } from './utils/docxExport';",
                              "import { buildJournalDocx, exportJournalToDocx } from './utils/docxExport';", 'import docx')
              s = replace_one(s, "import { buildJournalBundle, triggerBundleDownload, downloadCoverCdOnly } from './utils/bundleExport';",
                              "import { triggerBundleDownload, downloadCoverCdOnly } from './utils/bundleExport';\nimport { buildCoverCdDocx } from './utils/coverCdExport';", 'import cover')
              s = replace_one(s, '  onArticleComplete?: (fileName: string) => void;',
                              '  onArticleComplete?: (fileName: string) => void;\n  onDownloadsConfirmed?: () => void;', 'props')
              s = replace_one(s, 'export default function App({ onArticleComplete }: JournalConverterAppProps) {',
                              'export default function App({ onArticleComplete, onDownloadsConfirmed }: JournalConverterAppProps) {', 'app signature')
              s = replace_one(s, '  const [isDownloadingBundle, setIsDownloadingBundle] = useState(false);',
                              '''  // ZAINNET_LINK7_TWO_DOCX_SAFE_CLOSE_20261109
            // Browser websites cannot observe the OS download manager. Require the user
            // to confirm both Word files exist before returning to the main menu.
            const [wordPairPhase, setWordPairPhase] = useState<'idle' | 'preparing' | 'requested' | 'error'>('idle');
            const [wordPairMessage, setWordPairMessage] = useState('');''', 'word state')
              helper='''  const makeSafeWordFileName = (value: string): string =>
              String(value || 'Mahasiswa').trim().slice(0, 45)
                .replace(/[\\\\/?%*:|"<>]/g, '').replace(/\\s+/g, '_') || 'Mahasiswa';
          
            // Prepare BOTH files before starting either browser download. A single error
            // never closes the article preview; it can be retried without regenerating AI.
            const requestTwoWordDownloads = async (readyArticle: JournalArticle) => {
              setWordPairPhase('preparing');
              setWordPairMessage('Menyiapkan Artikel Word dan Cover CD Word...');
              try {
                const [articleBlob, coverBlob] = await Promise.all([
                  buildJournalDocx(readyArticle), buildCoverCdDocx(readyArticle),
                ]);
                if (articleBlob.size < 100 || coverBlob.size < 100) {
                  throw new Error('Salah satu dokumen Word yang dihasilkan kosong.');
                }
                const title = makeSafeWordFileName(readyArticle.metadata?.judul || 'Artikel');
                const name = makeSafeWordFileName(readyArticle.metadata?.nama || 'Mahasiswa');
                triggerBundleDownload(articleBlob, `Artikel_Jurnal_${title}.docx`);
                triggerBundleDownload(coverBlob, `Cover_CD_${name}.docx`);
                setWordPairPhase('requested');
                setWordPairMessage('Dua unduhan Word sudah diminta ke browser. Periksa folder Download dan izinkan beberapa unduhan bila diminta. Jika ada yang belum tersimpan, klik Unduh Ulang.');
              } catch (err: any) {
                console.error('[ZAIN.NET Link7] Gagal menyiapkan dua DOCX:', err);
                setWordPairPhase('error');
                setWordPairMessage(`Dua Word belum siap: ${err?.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan.'} Halaman tetap terbuka, silakan coba Unduh Ulang.`);
              }
            };
          
            const retryTwoWordDownloads = async () => {
              if (!article || wordPairPhase === 'preparing') return;
              // Always use current article so manual edits are included in both documents.
              await requestTwoWordDownloads(article);
            };
          
            const confirmTwoWordDownloads = () => {
              if (wordPairPhase !== 'requested') return;
              // The user confirms both files exist; the parent will now close the module.
              onDownloadsConfirmed?.();
            };
          
          '''
              s = replace_one(s, '  // Handle Journal AI Generation (Multi-stage process to prevent JSON truncation/timeouts)',
                              helper+'  // Handle Journal AI Generation (Multi-stage process to prevent JSON truncation/timeouts)', 'helper')
              s = replace_one(s,
          '''      setArticle(fullArticle);
                onArticleComplete?.(`${(fullArticle.metadata as any)?.judul || 'Artikel'}.docx`);
                setGenerationStatus({ stage: 0, message: '', percent: 100 });
                setActiveTab('preview');''',
          '''      setArticle(fullArticle);
                setActiveTab('preview');
                setGenerationStatus({ stage: 0, message: '', percent: 100 });
                // Record creation/quota ONCE, without closing the module.
                onArticleComplete?.(`${(fullArticle.metadata as any)?.judul || 'Artikel'}.docx`);
                // Automatically request two standalone Word files, not a ZIP.
                await requestTwoWordDownloads(fullArticle);''', 'generation finish')
              s = replace_one(s, '      onArticleComplete?.(`Artikel_${article.id}.docx`);',
                              '      // Re-download does not re-record the session or consume another quota.', 'manual docx')
              st='  // Handle Complete Bundle Export (.zip Artikel + Cover CD)'
              en='  // Open Editor Modal for a specific section'
              if s.count(st)!=1 or s.count(en)!=1 or s.index(st)>=s.index(en):
                  raise RuntimeError('Could not locate old ZIP export block')
              s=s[:s.index(st)]+s[s.index(en):]
              if s.count('onDownloadBundle={handleDownloadBundle}') != 2:
                  raise RuntimeError('Expected two ZIP UI callbacks')
              s='\n'.join(v for v in s.split('\n') if 'onDownloadBundle={handleDownloadBundle}' not in v)
              s=replace_one(s, '        isDownloading={isDownloadingDocx || isDownloadingCoverCd || isDownloadingBundle}',
                            '        isDownloading={isDownloadingDocx || isDownloadingCoverCd || wordPairPhase === \'preparing\'}', 'Header downloading prop')
              s=replace_one(s, '            isDownloadingBundle={isDownloadingBundle}',
                            '            isDownloadingBundle={false}', 'preview downloading prop')
              # Show a persistent confirmation / retry bar. Do not close without explicit
              # receipt confirmation: most browsers have no download-completion API.
              s=replace_one(s,
          '''      {/* Main Workspace Body */}''',
          '''      {/* 2-file download confirmation stays visible until the user confirms. */}
                {article && (
                  <div role="status" className="sticky top-0 z-40 mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl bg-blue-950 text-white p-4 shadow-xl border-b-4 border-cyan-400">
                    <p className="font-bold text-base">Artikel selesai — 2 File Word (tanpa ZIP)</p>
                    <p className="text-sm mt-1" aria-live="polite">{wordPairMessage}</p>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-3">
                      <button type="button" onClick={retryTwoWordDownloads}
                        disabled={wordPairPhase === 'preparing'}
                        className="rounded-lg bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                        {wordPairPhase === 'preparing' ? 'Menyiapkan 2 Word...' : 'Unduh Ulang 2 File Word'}
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" onClick={handleDownloadDocx}
                        disabled={isDownloadingDocx || wordPairPhase === 'preparing'}
                        className="rounded-lg bg-slate-700 px-4 py-2 font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                        Unduh Artikel.docx
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" onClick={handleDownloadCoverCd}
                        disabled={isDownloadingCoverCd || wordPairPhase === 'preparing'}
                        className="rounded-lg bg-slate-700 px-4 py-2 font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                        Unduh Cover_CD.docx
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" onClick={confirmTwoWordDownloads}
                        disabled={wordPairPhase !== 'requested'}
                        className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2 font-bold disabled:opacity-50">
                        Saya Sudah Menerima Kedua File — Kembali ke Beranda
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-blue-100 mt-2">
                      Browser dapat memblokir unduhan otomatis ganda. ZAIN.NET tidak akan kembali ke beranda sebelum Anda mengonfirmasi kedua file sudah tersimpan.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}
          
                {/* Main Workspace Body */}''', 'download confirmation UI')
              return s
          
          
          def fix_modal(original: str) -> str:
              s=original
              if 'ZAINNET_LINK7_SAFE_CLOSE_PARENT_20261109' in s:
                  return s
              at='  const handleAutoFinishDownload = (fileName: string, reason: string) => {'
              extra='''  // ZAINNET_LINK7_SAFE_CLOSE_PARENT_20261109
            // Generation completion is NOT a download completion signal.
            const handleLink7GenerationReady = (fileName: string) => {
              if (!tool || done.current) return;
              done.current = true;
              setStatus('Artikel selesai. Menyiapkan 2 file Word. Modul tetap terbuka sampai keduanya dikonfirmasi terunduh.');
              recordSessionCompleted(tool, effectiveUserId, { fileName, reason: 'Artikel Link 7 selesai dibuat' }, [], 0);
              Promise.resolve(finishRef.current?.(tool, 'Artikel Link 7 selesai dibuat')).catch((err) => {
                setStatus('Artikel selesai, tetapi pencatatan kuota tertunda: ' + (err?.message || 'Periksa akun.'));
              });
            };
            const handleLink7DownloadsConfirmed = () => {
              if (!done.current) return;
              setStatus('Dua file Word dikonfirmasi terunduh. Kembali ke menu utama...');
              setCompleted(true);
              setTimeout(() => onClose(), 1200);
            };
            const isLink7 = tool?.id === 'art-7' || tool?.url === 'internal://journal-converter' || tool?.url === '/journal-converter';
          '''
              s=replace_one(s,at,extra+at, 'parent handler')
              s=replace_one(s,
                           '<button aria-label="Kembali ke menu" onClick={onClose}><X size={24}/></button>',
                           '''<button aria-label="Kembali ke menu" onClick={() => {
                  if (isLink7 && done.current) {
                    setStatus('Periksa kedua unduhan Word terlebih dahulu dan tekan tombol konfirmasi di bawah hasil artikel.');
                    return;
                  }
                  onClose();
                }}><X size={24}/></button>''', 'parent close guard')
              s=replace_one(s,
          '''              onArticleComplete={(outFileName) => {
                          handleAutoFinishDownload(
                            outFileName,
                            'Penyusunan naskah artikel ilmiah + Cover CD (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite) selesai'
                          );
                        }}''',
          '''              onArticleComplete={(outFileName) => {
                          handleLink7GenerationReady(outFileName);
                        }}
                        onDownloadsConfirmed={handleLink7DownloadsConfirmed}''',
                           'Link7 callbacks')
              return s
          
          
          def fix_cover(original: str) -> str:
              if 'ZAINNET_LINK7_COVER_BASE_PATH_20261109' in original:
                  return original
              return replace_one(original,
                 "  const response = await fetch('/covercd-template.docx', { cache: 'force-cache' });",
                 "  // ZAINNET_LINK7_COVER_BASE_PATH_20261109: GitHub Pages lives under /Karyazainnet/.\n  const response = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}covercd-template.docx`, { cache: 'force-cache' });",
                 'Cover CD base path')
          
          
          def main():
              originals={p:p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in (APP,MODAL,COVER)}
              modified={APP:fix_app(originals[APP]),MODAL:fix_modal(originals[MODAL]),COVER:fix_cover(originals[COVER])}
              for path,content in modified.items():
                  path.write_text(content,encoding='utf-8')
                  print(f'{path}: updated={content!=originals[path]}, lines={content.count(chr(10))+1}')
          
          if __name__=='__main__':
              main()
          PY_FIX
          python3 /tmp/zainnet_fix_link7.py
      - name: Check correct scope
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git diff --stat
          git diff --name-only | while IFS= read -r f; do
            case "$f" in
              src/journalConverter/App.tsx|src/components/ToolViewerModal.tsx|src/journalConverter/utils/coverCdExport.ts) ;;
              *) echo "Unexpected modification: $f"; exit 1 ;;
            esac
          done
          grep -q ZAINNET_LINK7_TWO_DOCX_SAFE_CLOSE_20261109 src/journalConverter/App.tsx
          grep -q ZAINNET_LINK7_SAFE_CLOSE_PARENT_20261109 src/components/ToolViewerModal.tsx
          grep -q ZAINNET_LINK7_COVER_BASE_PATH_20261109 src/journalConverter/utils/coverCdExport.ts
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Check production build
        env:
          VITE_BASE_PATH: /Karyazainnet/
          VITE_API_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.API_BASE_URL }}
        run: npm run build
      - name: Commit source changes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add src/journalConverter/App.tsx src/components/ToolViewerModal.tsx src/journalConverter/utils/coverCdExport.ts
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Already patched; no changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "Fix Link7: request two DOCX before user-confirmed return home"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
